# Rows that say `to: result` (the first result only) for a function with more than one result, and are meant:
# the other results (the error) never hold the arguments or the receiver. One symbol per line, the reason after `#`.
# Read by TestGoRowsThatSayResultAreForOneResult. Anything else says `to: results`.
(*os/exec.Cmd).CombinedOutput # the error is *ExitError or a start failure: "exit status N", no output of the program in it (the output is the first result)
(*os/exec.Cmd).StdoutPipe # the error is "Stdout already set" or "StdoutPipe after process started": no data
(*os/exec.Cmd).StderrPipe # the error is "Stderr already set" or "StderrPipe after process started": no data
